title: spSheaf: sheaf-theoretic spatial domain inference from raw molecules without cell segmentation
description: Source code, experiment scripts, figure pipeline and tracked result tables (reported/) for the spSheaf manuscript. spSheaf infers spatial domains from molecule-level spatial transcriptomics without cell segmentation: kernel-density expression fibers on a grid, local principal-component stalks, SVD restriction maps and the resulting edge disagreement, which attenuates transitions between expression programs during clustering. Version 0.2.0 is the version of the Nature Methods submission; every number in the manuscript is reproducible from reported/ and the commands listed there.
